featured_reviews.name: Rahul Raut
featured_reviews.review_text:
Only recommended if you have emergency.
Overall, I had bad experience. I had to admit my dad, the emergency ward took care of him well, and I have no complaint about it.

But after that, it's just way too bad. Money is their primary objective.
1. A junior doctor, who came to check my dad's health in the morning and just asked him 'How are you?', upon getting positive answer, she told him to not to have too much salt in your food. She didn't checked anything, nor even touched him. The hospital charged us 600 Rs for that 30 sec conversation.
2. Some staff was helpful, but not all of them, turning on lights, moving beds, talking loudly, all of that in the middle of a night, which totally disturbed the environment.
3. Hygiene is maintained in some parts, like emergency rooms, other rooms/wards are unhygienic. Beds were smelly, unhygienic bathroom/washrooms, loose taps.
4. They'll try to get as much as money from you. My dad was totally fine after 5 hrs, but the hospital staff told us to keep him for another 4 days. We denied, then they started to give us different explanation, which was quite frightening, surprisingly, everyone else had same experience, including a person, who had mild fever. I asked our family doctor and showed him the reports and he told us that he's fine, but hospital staff kept insisting, but we took the discharge anyway, and visited my family doctor right away, he told that my dad was totally fine and there was no need to keep him for another 4 days.

I will be only recommend this hospital, if you have emergency, and if other hospitals are full.
